title: The corrected K vs PB result from the --index regrade is published under evals/d23
body:
Why: state review D3: the grader applied patches without --index; .krn/runs/d23-regrade/table.md regraded saved patches (3 cells differ: 476P, 478K, 499P) but no corrected K vs PB total was published, so the headline is still 41/57 vs 35/56 (+8.9 pp, p=0.227).
Outcome: node evals/d23/regrade.ts (or analysis.ts) prints the corrected paired K - PB over every regraded unit with counts, CI and p, and the table plus that summary are committed under evals/d23/ as regrade-index.md; no model session runs.
Files: evals/d23/regrade.ts, evals/d23/analysis.ts, evals/d23/regrade-index.md, test/evals/.
Proof: the committed summary line names K n/N, PB n/N, the difference, CI and p; a test on a verbatim slice of the regrade table reproduces the counts.
